name: kernel
description: Framework-neutral Agent Forge 2.0 contracts, transactional Task and lifecycle authority, and bounded deterministic Coordinator/Worker execution

capabilities.name: kernel.contracts
capabilities.description: Typed Task, AgentSpec, Handoff, Artifact, Approval, budget, permission, failure, degraded-result, and state-transition contracts

capabilities.name: kernel.task_authority
capabilities.description: Versioned SQLite Task/checkpoint repository with idempotency, compare-and-set, atomic checkpoints, and bounded execution claims

capabilities.name: kernel.execution
capabilities.description: Single-attempt deterministic Coordinator/direct/Worker-as-tool loop with AgentSpec authorization, finite structural budgets, cancellation, timeout, duplicate protection, and Run/Step/Event correlation

capabilities.name: kernel.lifecycle_authority
capabilities.description: Persisted Handoff ownership transfer, immutable Artifact digest/provenance/supersession, scoped Approval decision and consumption, CAS idempotency, and append-only domain audit

health_checks.command: python -c "import modules.kernel; assert modules.kernel.TaskRepository; assert modules.kernel.KernelExecutionEngine; assert modules.kernel.LifecycleRepository"
health_checks.description: Verify the formal Kernel package, Task authority, bounded execution loop, and Slice 3 lifecycle authority import

storage.description: Dedicated Kernel Task, claim, checkpoint, Handoff, Artifact, Approval, idempotency, and append-audit authority; raw Agent or Artifact content is not stored
